timingModel: For each SpriteAnimation, if animTime exists it is treated by the current planner frame sampler as total duration divided evenly across explicit Frame children. If omitted, sampler fallback is frameMs × frame count (175 ms × count from items.json). This is a measured software interpretation, not proof of the original client timing behavior. Generic curves use KeyFrame first value as normalized time and remaining values as sampled value vector in the current interpreter.

c.v: You can customize the Anomaly Aura from this popup.
To set the colors for the styles you need to enter RGB(Red, Green, Blue) values. To separate the individual values, you need to use a comma.
